line.comment: * since ZH 2.0 also used by ZH.SyntheticDawnCompletion to spawn Phanon ships
* write to logfile 1 append=[TRUE] printf: fmt='Creating raider Squadron for Teladi', null, null, null, null, null
* Buffed the Yakis during their activation.
* write to logfile 1 append=[TRUE] printf: fmt='Needs: %s', $needs, null, null, null, null
* First spawn an M3 temporary leader.
* write to log file 1 append=[TRUE] printf: fmt='Added Raider leader %s to sector %s', $leader, $homebase.sector, null, null, null
* Ease the selection of support ships (ie. passing fighters before carriers; don't really know why it's working).
* Expanded 2.2: Can spawn missile boats for Battle Groups besides M7. 50% chance.
* We don't add fighters to carriers here. See comment in Mayhem.Monitor.Autopopulate.Ship.
* Expanded 2.2: Only if it is not a missile boat, i.e. ship does not have missile turrets.
* Mordan8 - Limit missiles for some ships to help with framerate. similar logic is found in Mayhem.Task.TemplateWhenReady.xml for ships built afterwards.
